verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents its own API keys for the REST API, SDK, and CLI. Keys carry "team-scoped permissions", so a credential can be confined to one team, and team admins can revoke keys belonging to other members. There is no evidence that keys can be limited to specific actions or resources, or made read-only, so true least privilege for an agent is unproven. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource or per-action scopes, read-only or limited-permission key options, key expiry/TTL, agent- or service-account-specific credentials, independent corroboration.
